origin: Generated only because pre-frozen RT-005 Phase B found the -1 day arm materially stronger than the post-announcement arm.

c01_paired_pre_post.cohort: All original selected historical trades with complete T-24h, T0 and T+24h opens in canonical RAW.
c01_paired_pre_post.pre_return: T-24h open to T0 entry open, BASE20 applied for comparability
c01_paired_pre_post.post_return: T0 entry open to T+24h open, BASE20
c01_paired_pre_post.inference: 10,000 paired sign-flip permutations of (post-pre), seed 20260927; report two-sided fraction |perm_mean| >= |observed_mean|.

c02_pre_tail_dependency.role: Characterize whether the pre-event anomaly is itself tail-driven.

c03_event_window_decomposition.cost: No trading-cost claim for subwindows; report gross bps only because this is mechanism decomposition, not an executable strategy.

c04_momentum_matched_placebo.cohort: Original selected trades with complete pre24h and post24h data.
c04_momentum_matched_placebo.candidate_pool: Same YYYY-MM and same UTC quarter-hour, actual date ±1 day excluded, complete pre24h and post24h required.
c04_momentum_matched_placebo.matching: For each event select the five candidate dates with smallest absolute difference between candidate pre24h gross return and actual event pre24h gross return; deterministic timestamp tie-break.
c04_momentum_matched_placebo.overlap: Reject and redraw any placebo portfolio with overlapping 24h post windows within a historical block.
c04_momentum_matched_placebo.interpretation: If matched momentum controls reproduce the post-event return, that challenges event-specific incremental information. If they do not, event timing retains incremental evidence. Diagnostic only.
